info.name: Omni User groups API
info.description:
The Omni REST API provides programmatic access to your Omni instance for managing users, documents, queries, schedules, and more.

Contact Support:
 Name: Omni Support

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the group to be replaced

request.description:
Replaces the specified user group. Per the SCIM 2.0 specification, `PUT` replaces the entire group resource, including its membership.

To add or remove individual members without replacing the full membership list, use the Update user group endpoint, which performs a partial update via `PATCH`.

request.description:
Updates the specified user group by applying a list of SCIM 2.0 patch operations. Use `PATCH` to add or remove individual members, or to rename the group, without affecting other attributes.

To replace the entire group resource (including the full membership list) in a single request, use the Replace user group endpoint.
